parameter_contract.address_or_coordinate: Changing the address or coordinate regenerates only the marker placement after a frozen geocode and keep-out check.
parameter_contract.artwork_asset: Changing the logo/image/icon regenerates only the marker silhouette after rights, aspect-ratio and minimum-feature checks.
parameter_contract.width_mm: The artwork width is independent from map scale and defaults to 16.5 mm for the 600 x 400 mm Berlin product.
parameter_contract.relief_height_mm: The marker relief is process-controlled and is not scaled with the map.
parameter_contract.semantic_tool: The marker reuses one of the four existing tools; it must not create a fifth filament assignment.
